LibRaw build with the Nikon HE (NEF High Efficiency, aka TicoRAW / JPEG-XS-like
"NEF compression = 13/14") decoder.

Source: community decoder from LibRaw PR #826 (yogthos/LibRaw branch
"nikon-he-decoder", head commit 499bfd4 = "Merge pull request #1 from
y-g-jiang/nikon-he-production", based on LibRaw master).

Additional fixes applied (documented in LibRaw PR #826 comments by RdWing,
11 Sep 2026):
  - src/decoders/nikon_he/nikon_he_bayer.cpp: bottom-edge reconstruction fix
    (use the already computed intermediate prediction instead of the clamped
    next-row prediction in the last tile row; three spots: lh_next_predicted,
    carry_next_pred, next_predict).
  - src/decoders/nikon_he/nikon_he_iqx_iqp_lut_data.h: keep loop bound k < 254
    to avoid the out-of-bounds read of kIqxIqpBreakpoints[256].
  (Not applied: exact PIH-vendor transfer function from PIH extension bytes,
    raw-GCLI packet mode - approximate LUT remains, max ~1 raw step error.)

Build: mingw-w64 gcc 7.2.0, statically linked (-static
-DLIBRAW_NOTHREADS), library + sample from the fork tree:
  g++ -DLIBRAW_NOTHREADS -O3 -I. -w -static -o dcraw_emu.exe
    samples/dcraw_emu.cpp -L./lib -lraw -lm -lws2_32
Zlib/JPEG/RawSpeed/DNG-SDK support disabled (Makefile.dist flags edited).

The app invokes it as:
  dcraw_emu.exe -w -H 2 -W -6 [-h] "<file>"   (PPM output, 16-bit)

Only "HE" (Bp regime 4/5) is decoded; "HE*" (Bp in {1,2,3}) is refused by
the decoder at the first-precinct-header check.

LibRaw is dual licensed (LGPL-2.1 / CDDL-1.0) - see LICENSE.LGPL and
LICENSE.CDDL. This decoder reverse-engineers a format for which intoPIX
claims patents (TicoRAW / JPEG XS); it is provided as is, no patent license.
